impact_assessment.why: Reforge run-3 stage 3 accepted the finding that the three-part guard is pasted at four call sites, so a future edit to one copy would drift acceptance between the API layer and the store
impact_assessment.benefits: One acceptance definition for priority across store and API; future priority changes land in one place

impact_assessment.mitigation: existing 57 tests must pass unchanged including the bool rejections at every layer; hygiene and strict check gates

impact_assessment.why: backlog audit: a single .bak means one bad save erases the last known-good store
impact_assessment.benefits: crash recovery window of two generations instead of one; atomic renames, no extra writes
impact_assessment.risks: contract: .bak/.bak.1 naming new but additive; dependency: none (os.replace, POSIX+Windows); concurrency: unchanged single-process; state: no tree on Windows
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first function tests prove generation content; full suite + strict check; validate commit subject
